import os,signal,time,pathlib,subprocess,requests
pid=int(pathlib.Path('/tmp/gearvault.pid').read_text()); os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM); time.sleep(1)
p=subprocess.Popen(['node','server.js'],cwd='/app',stdout=open('/tmp/gearvault-final.log','w'),stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=os.environ.copy()); pathlib.Path('/tmp/gearvault.pid').write_text(str(p.pid)); time.sleep(3)
print('poll',p.poll(),'syntax',subprocess.run(['node','-c','public/app.js'],cwd='/app').returncode,subprocess.run(['node','-c','server.js'],cwd='/app').returncode)
for uid,path in [('aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa','/api/overview'),('33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333','/api/operations')]:
 r=requests.get('http://localhost:3000'+path,headers={'X-Demo-User':uid},timeout=8); print(path,r.status_code,'customers' in r.json(),len(r.json().get('customers',[])))
print('secrets grep',subprocess.run("grep -R --exclude-dir=node_modules -E 'sk_(live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9]' /app",shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
print('files',subprocess.run(['find','/app','-maxdepth','2','-type','f','-printf','%P\n'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
